title: Lifting an idempotent modulo an ideal after an etale base change that is an isomorphism on the quotient
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma lifts an idempotent of an integral algebra modulo an ideal after an etale base change which induces an isomorphism modulo that ideal. The proof picks a lift of the idempotent, applies the integrality helper to obtain a monic polynomial vanishing at that lift modulo the ideal, and then uses the factorisation lemma to split that polynomial, after an etale base change of the required kind, into factors congruent to a power of the variable and to a power of the variable minus one. The two evaluations of the factors at the lifted element multiply to zero, so their common vanishing locus avoids the closed set cut out by the ideal; closedness of the integral map on spectra produces a single element whose localisation separates the two loci, after which the two loci are disjoint and cover the spectrum, so that the corresponding idempotent lifts the given one by uniqueness of the splitting.
